title: 浮子付きレーンロープを巻いた移動式リール
titleEn: Mobile pool lane-rope reel with threaded floats
description: プールのレーンロープ収納場所や用具庫に置く移動式リール一式。四つのキャスター付き架台、押し手、軸受、開口スポーク側板と巻胴、手回しクランク、一本の連続ロープに穴あき浮子を通して巻いた形状を造形しています。浮子はこの一式の構成部品であり、別モデルとして数えません。水面・プール壁は付属せず、巻取り、走行、浮力、張力保持、耐荷重や競技・安全認証の機能はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.467 × 1.224 × 0.866 m、29,212三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A complete mobile lane-rope storage reel for a pool equipment area or store room, with a four-caster frame, push handle, bearings, open spoked flanges and drum, hand crank, and bored float segments visibly threaded along one continuous wound rope. Floats are components of this single asset, not separately counted models. Water and pool walls are omitted; no winding, rolling, flotation, tension retention, load rating or competition/safety certification is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.467 × 1.224 × 0.866 m; 29,212 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
